name: Fredis Beleris - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2024
part_text:
The report does not change any law. It sets out the Petitions Committee's views on how petitions were handled in 2024 and asks for improvements. It calls for clearer, jargon-free replies to petitioners, better public information about what the EU can and cannot act on, more transparency when the Commission pursues countries for breaking EU law, and a petitions website that works for people with disabilities, including sign language users.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests and recommendations to the Commission and Parliament.
- **Who it affects:** People who petition the European Parliament, especially disabled and deaf petitioners.
- **What happens next:** Parliament sends the text to the Commission, Council and Ombudsman; they decide whether to act.
